title: Which team spends the most?
hints: README → New syntax: the `NR == FNR {...; next}` two-file pattern. Give users.csv first.
File 1: remember `team[user_id] = team`. File 2: for paid USD orders, add the amount to `s[team[user_id]]`. END: print, then sort by total.
`awk 'NR == FNR {c[$1] = $2; next} {print $1, c[$2]}' colors.txt items.txt` looks up each item's color.
`awk -F, 'NR == FNR {team[$1] = $4; next} $5 == "paid" && $4 == "USD" {s[team[$2]] += $3} END {...}' users.csv orders.csv | sort -k2,2nr` (with the `$DATA/` paths).
